rows.note: Use 保養 as the all-purpose everyday noun for keeping equipment or systems in good working order.

example.english: This air conditioner needs regular maintenance.
example.traditional: 呢部冷氣機要定期保養。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 jiu3 ding6 kei4 bou2 joeng5

rows.note: Use this for money paid to support one's children, especially after separation or divorce.

example.english: After the divorce, they have to pay child maintenance every month.
example.traditional: 離婚之後，佢要每個月畀子女撫養費。
example.jyutping: lei4 fan1 zi1 hau6 keoi5 jiu3 mui5 go3 jyut6 bei2 zi2 neoi5 fu2 joeng5 fai3

rows.note: Use this for alimony paid or ordered for a former spouse after divorce.

example.english: After the divorce, they have to pay their ex-wife monthly maintenance.
example.traditional: 離婚之後，佢要每個月畀前妻贍養費。
example.jyutping: lei4 fan1 zi1 hau6 keoi5 jiu3 mui5 go3 jyut6 bei2 cin4 cai1 sim6 joeng5 fai3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a software version that mainly fixes bugs and improves stability.

example.english: This maintenance release mainly fixes bugs and makes the system more stable.
example.traditional: 呢個維護版本主要係修正錯誤，令系統穩定啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wai4 wu6 baan2 bun2 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 sau1 zing3 co3 ng6 ling6 hai6 tung2 wan2 ding6 di1
